new.name: cve-2026-104099-fabio-path-acl-bypass
new.description: CVE-2026-104099 - Fabio - Critical 9.1 - Remote - Path-equivalence ACL bypass. Fabio selects the route from the raw unnormalized path, so /./admin/, /%2e/admin/, //admin/ and /x/../admin/ miss the protected route, skip its allow/auth gate, and the backend serves the protected page. Loopback lab, 1.7.2 vulnerable, 1.7.3 fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-134834

new.name: CVE-2026-134835

new.name: CVE-2026-134824
new.description: nektos/act <0.2.98: checkLocalPath uses only lexical filepath.IsLocal() — untrusted .actrc --eventpath symlink to a host file gets copied into the job container. Verbatim Go funcs from dfa7f89^ vs escapesWorkdir fix: symlink accepted on vuln, rejected on fixed

new.name: CVE-2026-134833

new.name: CVE-2026-134822
new.description: Sustainsys.Saml2 <1.0.4/2.11.1: CheckSignature splits query params on every '=' and drops data after the second segment — appending '=evil' to RelayState bypasses signature verification. Verbatim C# parse from 5586ddf^ vs fix: tampered value verifies on vuln, fails on fixed

new.name: CVE-2026-134832
new.description: Vim <9.2.1352: expand_tag_fname checks path_with_url before ExpandOne unescapes http:\/\/ — crafted tags file bypasses tagsecure and netrw fetches attacker URL with expanded env vars. Real compiled binaries 1-1351 vs 1-1352: E429 with $HOME leak vs E1576

new.name: CVE-2026-134820
new.description: Gunicorn <27.0.0: ASGI parser converts Content-Length with int(), accepting '+5'/'1_0' — desynchronizes framing with RFC 9110 proxies (request smuggling). Verbatim _finalize_headers from 400f5ec^ vs strict isdigit fix: '+5'->CL=5 on vuln, rejected on fixed

new.name: CVE-2026-134805
new.description: Zipline <4.8.3: OIDC avatar flow fetches the untrusted 'picture' URL from the userinfo response with no checks — a hostile IdP triggers SSRF to internal services. Verbatim fetchToDataURL vs ca431b9 fetchExternal: metadata URL fetched on vuln, rejected on fixed

new.name: CVE-2026-134817
new.description: mcp-server-kubernetes <4.2.0: dash-prefixed positional operands reach kubectl argv — an MCP client injects '--filename' to read server-host files. Verbatim assertNotFlagLike from 588d4949: flag enters argv on vuln, McpError on fixed

new.name: CVE-2026-134815
new.description: simple-git <4.1.0: allowUnsafePack blocks --exec only for push — injected --exec on ls-remote/archive/fetch-pack/send-pack runs an attacker-named program. Real npm 4.0.0 vs 4.1.0 (c8ee6bb): marker executed via raw()/listRemote() on vuln, rejected on fixed

new.name: CVE-2026-134814
new.description: binary-parser <2.3.1: string options interpolated verbatim into generated parser JS — 'x+(globalThis.INJECTED=1,0)' as a length option executes attacker code. Real npm 2.3.0 vs 2.3.1 (110206b): global flag set on vuln, 'Invalid reference' on fixed

new.name: CVE-2026-134808
new.description: Gogs <0.14.4: isRepositoryGitPath only trims trailing dots/spaces — NTFS aliases 'git~1' and '.git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION' bypass the guard, allowing writes into a repo's .git dir. Verbatim Go functions from 4301704^ vs fix: both aliases accepted on vuln, blocked on fixed

new.name: CVE-2026-134821
new.description: Gunicorn <27.0.0: pure-Python ASGI parser buffers CRLF-less lines without limit and rescans the whole buffer per read — unauthenticated memory/CPU exhaustion. Verbatim find() path vs 3007d52 _find_line(): 2 MiB buffered/34.6 MiB rescanned on vuln, rejected at ~1.1 MiB on fixed
